rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING MONOPOLIES, ATTEMPT TO MONOPOLIZE AN INDUSTRY OR LINE OF COMMERCE, MANIPULATION OF PRICES OF COMMODITIES, ASSET ACQUISITION AND INTERLOCKING MEMBERSHIPS IN THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF COMPETING CORPORATE BODIES AND PRICE DISCRIMINATION AMONG CUSTOMERS, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Anti-Trust Act
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Anti-Trust Act.\" The bill penalizes combinations or conspiracies in restraint of trade and all forms of artificial machinations that will injure, destroy or prevent free market competition.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2004-10-25

rows.author: E059
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING AN ELECTIVE PUBLIC OFFICIAL FROM RESIGNING HIS ELECTIVE OFFICE TO ACCEPT AN APPOINTMENT TO ANY GOVERNMENT OFFICE AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The bill disqualifies an elective official who resigns his elective office from being appointed to any government position during the unexpired term of the office he resigned from.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2004-10-25

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2005-12-14, transmitted to on 2005-12-22 and received by the Senate on 2005-12-22
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 53, AS AMENDED, BY INCLUDING WITHIN ITS COVERAGE JOURNALISTS FROM BROADCAST, NEWS AGENCIES AND INTERNENT PUBLICATIONS
rows.abstract: The bill includes within the coverage of RA 53 (Sotto Law) journalists from broadcast stations, news agencies and internet publication. With their inclusion in the ambit of RA 53, journalists can not be compelled to reveal the source of a confidential news report or information except when a court or or committee of Congress finds that the revelation is demanded for the security of the State.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04835

committee_action.remarks: Committee Report No. 1153 substituted by House Bill No. 4835

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING TAXES ON IDLE AGRICULTURAL, RESIDENTIAL AND INDUSTRIAL LANDS, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: The Idle Lands Tax of 2004
rows.abstract: \"The Idle Lands Tax of 2004.\" The bill proposes the imposition of a 5% tax on idle agricultural, residential and industrial lands based on the fair market value or zonal value, whichever is higher. The proposed tax shall be over and above the real estate taxes imposed by the local government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2004-10-25

rows.author: D086
rows.mother_status: Senate agreed on Conference Committee Report on 2007-02-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING COMPENSATION TO VICTIMS OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS DURING THE ENTIRE PERIOD OF MARTIAL LAW FROM SEPTEMBER 21, 1972 TO FEBRUARY 25, 1986 AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Martial Law Victims Compensation Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Martial Law Victims Compensation Act of 2004.\" The measure sets aside part of the recovered Marcos ill-gotten wealth for the victims of martial law. It provides for the compensation and manner of allocation of the compensation to the human rights violation victim. It creates the Commission for the Compensation and Recognition of Martial Law Victims and provides for the Commission's powers and functions.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03315

rows.author: D086
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING SEPTEMBER 21 OF EVERY YEAR AS A \"NATIONAL DAY OF REMEMBRANCE\" IN MEMORY OF THE STRUGGLES AND SACRIFICES OF THE HEROES AND MARTYRS OF THE MARTIAL LAW ERA
rows.title_short: National Day of Remembrance Act
rows.abstract: \"National Day of Remembrance Act.\" In recognition of the struggles and sacrifices of the heroes and martyrs of the martial law era, the bill declares September 21 of every year as a special working holiday to be known as the \"National Day of Remembrance.\"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2004-10-25

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ACCELERATE THE DEVELOPMENT OF ALL BARANGAYS BY PROVIDING FUNDS FOR MICRO ENTERPRISES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Philippine Fund for Progress Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Philippine Fund for Progress Act of 2004.\" The bill creates an P80 billion Philippine Fund for Progress and allocates P2.0 million to each of the 40,000 barangays in the country for lending to deserving micro enterprises.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SMALL BUSINESS & ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT since 2004-10-25
